correctness.rationale: For every integer five-set, translation reduces to {0,a,b,c,D} with 1<=a<b<c<D. Enumerating all D=4..23 covers sum_D binomial(D−1,3)=binomial(23,4)=8855 sets, and each 3A has at most 35 unordered triples with repetitions. An independently written exact bitmask computation recovered the entire 22-entry m(s) table, the sole 35-at-D23 case and all four reported normalized extremizers. Each lower diameter is eliminated by this exhaustive finite domain, and every claimed optimum has a witness. Rajagopal Theorem 1.7, not finite enumeration, excludes s=14 globally, completing the universe of cardinalities.
residual_risks: Exact finite classification assumes the enumeration covers every translation-normalized five-set of diameter≤23, which is verified combinatorially.
